proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11418.3 *valkhala/*volkala explicitly gives Nepali bokro and Hindi boklā bark. The o-vowel survey forms select section 3 rather than the valkala head. Exact survey form bokla is retained.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6251 dākṣiṇa explicitly gives Prakrit dāhiṇa/ḍāhiṇa and eastern dāhin/dāhina right. The selected retroflex-initial Tharu and Oriya dahano forms fit this documented family. Exact survey form ḍahɪn is retained.
